title: Salsa Dip 450g

drivers.name: Price increase (6.1%)
drivers.evidence: Historical price increases (non-promo) show mild demand drop. Recent $3.46 weeks average 70.8 units (1.17x baseline), but 2026-04-13 (x0.96) shows pullback. No promotion, so lift not expected. Noise-adjusted price effect: -5%.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 60.6. The price is raised to $3.46 (+6.1% vs regular). No events or promotions are scheduled. Recent weeks at $3.46 show mixed results: 2026-04-06 (x1.45), 2026-04-13 (x0.96), but no promotion. Past promotions at similar price points show a noise-adjusted lift of x1.36, but this is a price increase, not a discount. Price increases typically reduce demand; the post-promotion effect is neutral (x1.0). The classical model suggests no uplift, and no named drivers exist. The recent price spike (2026-04-06) was not promotional. With no evidence of demand increase from price, and a price increase, we expect a slight decline. The noise-adjusted effect of a price hike is modest and uncertain. Shrink toward 1.0.

It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-29% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
